question: How do I book a workspace online?
summary:
To book a workspace online, visit the customer website and select a physical desk or room on the interactive map. Choose your desired date, start time, and duration, then provide the required guest contact details. If you have a Unique Customer ID from a previous confirmed booking, you may optionally enter it; otherwise, leave it blank. Submit the request, then use the official private payment page to upload proof of payment within 60 minutes. Your reservation is only confirmed after an administrator reviews your payment proof and allocates the physical unit.

Please note that submitting a request or receiving a queue number does not secure a workspace. You must complete the payment and upload proof via the official link before the session expires. Only the final confirmation email establishes your assigned spot and authorized reservation interval.
